details.description: Llama 2 13B Chat is the 13-billion-parameter fine-tuned chat model in Meta's Llama 2 family, built on the base Llama 2 13B pretrained checkpoint using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) for dialogue alignment, per Meta's model card. It is optimized for assistant-like chat and accepts a conversation history rather than a single completion prompt, and was trained on 2 trillion tokens of publicly available text between January and July 2023 (pretraining cutoff September 2022). Meta's Hugging Face organization now lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind the current Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4 families.
advantages: Reports 62.18% on TruthfulQA on Meta's fine-tuned safety evaluation, higher than the 7B chat model, per Meta's model card.
Reports 0.00% toxic generations on ToxiGen in Meta's fine-tuned safety evaluation, per Meta's model card.
Uses supervised fine-tuning and RLHF for dialogue alignment, per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Meta states intended use is English only, and that safety testing 'has not covered, nor could it cover, all scenarios.'
Superseded by later Llama generations: Meta's Hugging Face organization lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4.
Pretraining knowledge cutoff of September 2022, per Meta's model card.
use_cases: Assistant-like conversational chat, per Meta's model card
Multi-turn dialogue applications that pass a chat history rather than a raw prompt

sources.title: Llama 2 foundation models from Meta are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart

notes: This is the SageMaker JumpStart artifact for the fine-tuned chat Llama 2 13B model; the AWS launch blog confirms the '-f' suffix denotes the chat/fine-tuned id, matching the catalog's /v1/chat/completions endpoint. ToxiGen (0.00%, lower is better) is not included in evaluations per the accuracy-only rule but is cited as an advantage. Capability benchmarks (MMLU, commonsense reasoning, etc.) on the shared Llama 2 model-card table are reported only for the pretrained sizes, not repeated for the chat-tuned variant, so only the fine-tuned safety table (TruthfulQA/ToxiGen) is used here. Catalog's 4096/4096 token limits match Meta's stated 4,096-token context.
